verdict.rationale: The product is itself a public API. It has a documented API reference (sonar-post with citations and search_results), a quickstart promising a first call in under 3 minutes, official type-safe SDKs with sync/async clients, streaming, retries and typed errors, and Search, Agent and OpenAI-compatible router endpoints. Hands-on probes confirm a live OpenAPI spec and llms.txt, and a community post corroborates that the API has long been available.
